Subject: Upfront commit & structured ramp — 36-month offer and follow-up

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — loved the discussion about how Greenline plans to embed contextual summaries into clinician workflows. Per our call, attached is a first-pass commercial structure to align on a 36-month committed arrangement with annual prepay and structured ramp. Highlights (high-level):

- Commitment: 36 months, annual prepay (invoiced at start of each year)
- Year 1 baseline: 10M tokens/month avg (billable units); Year 1 effective price: $0.012/token (15% term discount off list)
- Year 2: 15M tokens/month avg (step-up ramp) — effective price: $0.010/token
- Year 3: 20M tokens/month avg — effective price: $0.009/token
- True-up: Annual usage true-up at end of each year; overages billed at the applicable committed-year rate.
- Early termination/reshuffle: Standard pro-rata true-up + agreed exit fee if terminating before year 2.

Rationale: this structure gives Greenline predictable unit economics while letting you optimize consumption over time. We can tighten the ramp or move to quarterly true-ups if procurement needs that.

Ask: Can you confirm whether your finance team prefers a flat three-equal-year invoice or the annual prepay we proposed? Also, any must-have procurement terms we should expect (e.g., PO timing, SOC 2 attestation language)?

I attached the PDF summary with the line-item math and a simple example showing net spend vs. usage for the first 18 months. Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

- Finance asks whether you can accommodate quarterly true-ups rather than annual — that helps our cash planning.
